name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She balances on one leg with the other extended behind her in a dancer's pose, both arms flowing in a wide arc as if guiding a tide, one hand palm-up lifting a ribbon of water that spirals around her body, the other trailing droplets, head tilted, a serene gaze to the camera. Sea wind billows her gown, train and hair. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: A ribbon of glowing {{MAGIC}} water spirals around her body and arms, droplets glittering on the wind.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
